name: Sümeg (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner of two stripes, blue at the hoist and yellow at the fly, charged at the centre with the town arms of Sümeg (a white shield with a red heart and a flower, with a helm, a crest and red, green and blue mantling) above the name SÜMEG in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Sümeg arms with helm, crest and mantling
